summary: Completed testing of financial fields feature for customers and suppliers. All backend APIs and frontend UI are working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Financial fields feature is fully implemented and tested. GET /api/customers and GET /api/suppliers return debitBalance, creditBalance, ajelBalance, overdueBalance, settledAmount, paymentPlanCount, and movements fields. Customer subaccounts (acc-customer-*) and supplier subaccounts (acc-supplier-*) are created in /api/accounts. Frontend displays financial fields in customer/supplier cards with expandable movements section.
verified_features: GET /api/customers returns financial fields (debitBalance, creditBalance, ajelBalance, overdueBalance, settledAmount, paymentPlanCount, movements)
GET /api/suppliers returns financial fields (debitBalance, creditBalance, ajelBalance, overdueBalance, settledAmount, paymentPlanCount, movements)
Customer subaccounts created with pattern acc-customer-{id} and code starting with 1103
Supplier subaccounts created with pattern acc-supplier-{id} and code starting with 2101
Customers page displays financial fields in cards
Suppliers page displays financial fields in cards
Expandable movements section shows transaction history
